neighbours.label: tokens continuing a university's name (' at' in 'University of X at Y', ' Rankings', ' Central')
fire: Her research on sleep was funded while she taught at the University of Illinois at Chicago.
Last month the dean of the University of Wisconsin at Madison announced new scholarships.
He earned a doctorate in chemistry from the University of Michigan before moving abroad.
Several faculty at the University of Massachusetts at Amherst signed the open letter.
The latest QS World University Rankings placed the school just outside the top fifty.
My cousin studies nursing at the University of South Florida in Tampa.
A linguist at the University of Hawaii at Manoa recorded the last fluent speakers.
The study was led by an economist at the University of Texas at Dallas.
quiet: Her research on sleep was funded while she worked at a hospital in downtown Chicago.
Last month the mayor of Madison, Wisconsin announced new bus routes for the city.
He earned a pilot's licence in Michigan before moving abroad.
Several farmers near Amherst, Massachusetts signed the open letter.
The latest restaurant guide placed the diner just outside the top fifty in the state.
My cousin works as a nurse at a clinic in Tampa, Florida.
A fisherman on the coast of Manoa, Hawaii recorded the strange whale songs.
The study was led by an economist working for a bank in Dallas, Texas.

notes: Card top examples: 'University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill', 'Temple University Rankings', 'University of Central Florida', UNH, GMU. Probe: ' at' in a University-of-X-at-Y name 0.43, ' Rankings' 0.46, ' at' after a non-university place 0.01. Near misses keep the place names but drop the university.
